Productivity and Costs
Second Quarter 2026, Revised
Nonfarm business sector labor productivity increased 1.4 percent in the second quarter of 2026, as output increased 1.7 percent and hours worked increased 0.3 percent. (All quarterly percent changes in this release are seasonally adjusted annualized rates.)
Unit labor costs in the nonfarm business sector increased 1.2 percent in the second quarter of 2026 rather than increasing 1.3 percent as previously reported, reflecting a 2.6-percent increase in hourly compensation and a 1.4-percent increase in productivity.
